verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the ROCm stack is open source and supports Linux. The Instinct tooling around it also points to a Linux-centric server environment: AMD SMI for driver management, a Kubernetes GPU Operator and a Docker container toolkit. However, nothing in the pack documents specific Linux driver releases for the MI355X or shows independent testing of the part on Linux; the community items are architecture analysis and inference benchmarks that never mention the OS or driver stack. Missing for 10: documented MI355X Linux driver release notes or a kernel/amdgpu support matrix, independent hands-on Linux testing of this part, and explicit confirmation that the MI355X is supported on Linux rather than only implied by ROCm generally.
